reviews.text: Great place! Stopped in to see their selection and was quickly impressed by the knowledge of the owner.  Will be going back tomorrow to buy substrate! Great prices too!
Rude!!!

The man who helped me was very nice! I was getting something as a gift, so I had no prior knowledge of what to look for, but he was very helpful and made evrything go by very smooth and fast. Would recommend, and will likely go back if I ever need anything else fish related :)
Love this place ive been coming her going on 2 years, staff is friendly & very knowledgeable.
Very cool shop I came at a bad time the employees were doing a salt dip to a few fish so I didn't get to ask any questions but I'll be back

Great store with a wide selection of both saltwater and freshwater fish. They've got all the equipment you could possibly need to both start up and maintain your aquarium. Extremely knowledgeable staff. Will be coming back for my aquarium needs
Excellent choice in local aquatic supplies

They always have beautiful cichlids. I've found some rare ones here, too. Great prices on discuss and I always found cool variations of clownfish when I had marine tanks. They also have seahorses pretty regularly. I don't really see them often, so it always cool to them here.

I have been going to South Seas Aquatics since their other location.  They've always been helpful with whatever I need.  Whether it's fish, rock, supplements or parts..they either have it, can get it or point me in the right direction.
Awesome one on one customer service! Clean store and wide variety of fish and plants. A must stop and shop!!

Great service. Best coral options in San Antonio, very helpful if you are a new hobbyist or an experienced one.  They do everything right!
The best place perfect

Price-wise it's overpriced. Specifically the axo which was small, about an inch and a half and was at $150 down to $100. Guppies also overpriced. Call around first to hunt.
Clean establishment and great staff very knowledgeable. I would recommend to friend and go back
Fantastic selection of corals!!

Its overpriced like 10 to 50 percent across the bored on everything. Have a fairly big selection but you can't afford most of it, cause absolutely everything has been priced higher then any other fish store in  Texas. so it really doesnt matter. Store seems more of a hang out for a few people and they really dont like be bothered by customers or their questions. Like how dare you bother them at work. If you looking for a 70 dollar coral or fish and want to pay a 60 percent mark up, and have employees angered that you are trying to make the purchase, then this is your store. Parking is usually good....
Great setup 😀 …

We were visiting from out of town, we aren't able to buy anything sadly due to being far from home and our plans. But wow! What a cute little shop thats worth checking out. The fish were all in healthy condition and the people working there were very kind to us.
Super knowledgeable and super chill associates. Theu had a very good selection of freshwater and saltwater fish. They also have a very good selection of freshwater plants.

Wouldn’t recommend anywhere else to go get your fish or aquarium needs from!did an amazing job on the transportation of my 150 gallon didn’t lose one fish.also maintains it and my tank always looks amazing David and Gary are the best!
Two stars because they had what we needed. Whoever it was that was working seemed so bothered that I had questions and I needed help.
Fish people unite!
Great store very knowledgeable.
Nice and very knowledgeable
I went for information on starting a new aquarium - they were completely uninterested in spending any time. The store was dark, wet, and the fish were not impressive at all.
Great store with lots of choices of salt and fresh water fish and coral.
These guys are great have alot of Knowledge and offer tons of help

For someone who knows nothing about aquariums (but was trying to build a tank for my newborn daughter) I found the owner and employees here extremely generous with their time, knowledge, and insights on several visits. Very kind people.

Exceptional Service and an Amazing Team!

I recently had the pleasure of working with South Seas Aquatics in San Antonio for the delivery of my new large fish tank, and I couldn't be happier with their service.

From start to finish, the team went above and beyond to ensure everything went well, and I have to give a huge shout out to David, Gary, and Andy for their incredible professionalism!

The delivery was seamless, with the team meticulously handling every aspect to ensure my tank arrive safely. They didn’t just meet my expectation, they exceeded them.

South Seas Aquatics have earned my highest recommendation. If you're looking for top-notch service and a team that truly cares, this is the place to go. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

Thank you, David, Gary, and Andy, for your outstanding work—you guys are the best!

I have had very great  experiences at south seas aquatics with my many fish i have purchased from them and the management (GARY JR GARY SENIOR AND DAVID give the best customer service .. i have nothing but great things to say about my experience with them they let me know when they receive new fish and they do an excellent job cleaning and servicing my tanks . David set up a 55 gallon tank and did an amazing job and I’m happy and do are  my new fish ..😃south seas aquatics is an ideal place for your fish  purchased . Awesome fish! Helpful employees, even listened to my story of ghost shrimp.
Got a cardinal plant and panda Cory cats. All adapted well in my newly cycled planted 39 gallon tall. Clean, welcoming, nice stock at least for me!
Great place. They have absolutely beautiful coral and a wonderful selection of fish.

Great bucket full collection of empty shells of all sizes for my boy's 5 hermit crabs 🦀 which are currently molting! THANK YOU for the 5 shells!!! 🐚
